info.title: VelarumPay Platform API
info.description: Canonical v0.1 API for pairing, Transaction Context, Payment Request, and status observation. The service never holds user private keys and never signs user transactions.

202.description: Enumeration-safe response for a new verification or returning-account access link

200.description: One-time email link verified; eligible merchant choices and a one-time session grant returned

201.description: HttpOnly merchant session cookie and CSRF proof issued

200.description: Domain verified; the first valid domain atomically activates an email-verified pending Merchant

201.description: Recipient draft and first immutable version created

200.description: Evidence accepted; activation follows the network-specific cooling policy
Verified version activated after the applicable network policy

201.description: Invitation claimed; wallet approval still required
Live identity facts revalidated and invitation approved

200.description: Invitation rejected by its target wallet
Approved invitation exchanged for scoped connection

201.description: Endpoint created; generated secret returned once

200.description: New secret returned once with bounded overlap
App device registered or idempotently confirmed

New token returned once; prior token invalidated
